contexts.text: It is not the paradisiacal pleasantnesses and beauties which affect; but the celestial spiritual things which are in them.
They not only affect the sight with pleasantness; but also the mind with happiness.
Their habitations will be changed into more pleasant ones.
The fluidity and pleasantness of the speech is thence.
Desire and delectation from pleasantness thence. Signified.
Delights of good, and pleasantnesses of truth... AC 3589.
Under Peace, see this reference. HH 288. HH 289.
And the land that it was pleasant () = that in this happiness are those in the Lord's Kingdom. Explained. AE 445:4.
The land pleasant, has relation to truth.
What is pleasant from truth. Signified, Explained.
The pleasantness or gladness of the affection of spiritual truth. Signified.
The pleasantness of the love of filling the mind and body with delights derived from opulence... is turned into sorrow.
Such a dog is represented when anyone is carried away to a contrary pleasantness.
The pleasant harp with the psaltery ().
Pleasantness is said of wisdom and the derivative perception of the understanding.
